text: Though the innate thirst for blood can never be fully eradicated, this Jade Blood Taoist, deeply versed in the Wind of Life, can greatly restrain her restless urges and impart this discipline to her allies.
The Blood Kiss is both curse and gift—it torments them endlessly, yet grants them supernatural power.
True Form of the Yue Zhuo

[Shadowdance] is the mysterious Great Moon Luan personally bestowed upon Hong Ying by the Moon Empress. Legend holds this bird carries a fragment of the Empress's power. Upon hearing its cry, the [Black Jade Crow Marquis] can commune with the Wind of Yin and transform into the divine bird Yue Zhuo.
A heroic spirit forever enshrined in history, forged through valor and resilience into an undying legend, inspiring the people of Cathay to press ever forward.
This form is cast from mysterious spirit jade. The terracotta guardians channel the Dragon Emperor's might, circulating and nourishing the lands of the Celestial Empire.
In life a hero among men, in death a mighty spirit—standing proud between heaven and earth, its glory unfading, its noble spirit unbroken.
Avatar of the Lords of Decay: Greed

[Shadowdance] is the mysterious Great Moon Luan personally bestowed upon Hong Ying by the Moon Empress. Legend holds this bird carries a fragment of the Empress's power. Upon hearing its cry, the [Black Jade Crow Marquis] can commune with the Wind of Yin and transform into the divine bird Yue Zhuo.
A mighty weapon that [Shadowdance] carried forth from the Moon Empress's garden. Its blade gleams bright as moonlight, wreathed in dark flames that can effortlessly unravel magic.

Hong Ying possesses an uncanny affinity for the Wind of Yin. His 'staff' is the ink-black flame that dances upon the edge of the Purifying Moon Blade—when channeling magic or cutting down foes, the dark flame rises and reshapes itself with terrifying power.

Legend says this white jade was carved by the Shadow Dragon itself. Its wearer can not only conceal their form but also move with the wind across the battlefield, striking down enemy commanders while cloaked in shadow.

This robe, light as a feather, was woven from the plumage offered by a hundred [Black Jade Crow Marquis]. It is both a mark of their recognition of Hong Ying and his final safeguard in moments of dire peril.
The Cassia Confidants bear the duty of gathering intelligence across the realm and carrying out assassinations and arrests. Only the Overseer may hold this token—to see it is to fear imprisonment.

The phantom of the divine bird Yue Zhuo often appears in Hong Ying's wake. After he took command of the Cassia Confidants, the [Black Jade Crow Marquis] who witnessed this whispered to him: this is the long-vanished power of the Shadow Dragon, a power steeped in suffering and sacrifice.
The eyes of the Celestial Court reach the ends of the earth; the span of crow wings can shroud heaven and earth alike—the protection of the Celestial Empire extends to every corner.
Hong Ying was born with an affinity for the power of Yin. His arts of assassination were taught to him personally by the Moon Empress—he arrives like a shadow, and departs like the wind.
The followers of Tzeentch believe their scheme is flawless, and so they drink and revel—while in the next room, someone is quietly sketching their portrait.
Swift as the wind, sudden as thunder, he moves alone through the enemy camp with peerless courage.
The long night is a shadow's finest hiding place. The deepest shadows always move alone, waiting for their moment—by the time the enemy arrives, word of them has already come first.
The Lord of the Shadow Crows commands the flock—he appears to walk alone, yet in the darkness, crows attend him unseen. Raise a hand, and the whole flock answers the call.
Amid the churning depths of espionage, he always emerges unscathed, guiding his agents through labyrinths of deception—a true master of the spy's trade.
The silhouette of the Celestial Court flickers faintly in the night, while black feathers glint beneath the moonlight, like countless jewels set into the sky.
This draconic steed is jet black from head to hoof, galloping ten thousand li by day and eight thousand by night—thus named “Cloudstrider of Ten Thousand Li.”
Muster riders, prepare soldiers, feed horses, sharpen blades, and strengthen formations—this is the path to victory.
Discipline yourself with introspection, reflect thrice daily, bask in the moon’s glow, carry the dignity of the Dragon Emperor—never falter in virtue or decorum.
Let golden steel reflect a loyal heart—leave no regrets nor unspoken laments.
You beasts and barbarian fiends—halt! Who dares face even half my hammer swing?!
His immense magical power, innate since birth, hammers and tempers Xuan Lie’s body day and night—granting him divine might to shatter mountains and tear down walls.

Golden helm, golden armor, cinnabar robe; purple eyes, crimson brows, azure mane. As drums thunder and banners flash, the earth trembles and the heavens stir. His mount is born of dragon blood—how could petty daemons escape? When we return in triumph, general, we shall lay down our arms together.
A golden hammer shaped like a beast's head, its striking end housing the spirit of a temple-guarding beast. Its blows fall like the swipe of a dragon's claw, scattering armies before it.
'Halfdan met the Dwarf Gerd when he won a drinking contest, and when the two escaped from the Dark Elves' Black Ark, a storm swept Gerd away, leaving behind only his old friend's heirloom rune-helm.'

'This suit of armor was forged by a renowned Dwarf master and inlaid with a long-lost thunder rune, capable of channeling the thunderous energy within Halfdan while also warding off the surrounding taint of Chaos.'

'After felling the giant chieftain known as the Bonecrusher in single combat, Halfdan claimed this golden rune from the giant's hoard. Its bearer commands boundless charisma, inspiring others to follow him willingly.'
'I shall raise Mjolnir high, unite the people of Kislev beneath a single banner, and cleanse the shame of old with the thunder of the heavens!'

'When the divine hammer descended amid crackling lightning, it left an unfading scar of lightning across Halfdan's chest. This scar renders the Chosen of Thor impervious to blade and untiring in battle.'
The clear skies of Kislev have long been shrouded in dark clouds. Today, the divine hammer descends, thunder roars—let it sweep away the gloom and wash clean the shame of old!
For too long, Norscan raiders, Skaven ratmen, and even Daemons of Chaos have plagued our homeland. It is time they taste the suffering they have inflicted upon us!
Countless loyal soldiers have shed their blood upon the wastelands, the city walls, our homes, and even our shrines—but blood and ice have forged our unbreakable bodies and wills.
Thor's blessing grants us unmatched speed and strength, letting us surge forward wrapped in the fury of destruction.
I always appear where my allies need me most. I will not fall. I—will never stop!
Behind us stands the Motherland, stands Kislev itself! Under Thor's watchful gaze, we shall stand as one!
I bear the glory of the Thunder God. In Thor's name I raise the divine hammer, and Chaos shall be barred from our homeland!
Every scar is a badge of honor; every battle shall bring us victory!
'It was this warhammer, fallen from the sky, that turned the page to a new chapter in Halfdan's life. When he grips its haft, he hears Thor's divine word, guiding him to triumph over all.'

Unbreakable strength applied to a weapon becomes unstoppable force. This warhammer, one that would take several Kroxigor to lift, moves in Gu Kahn's grip as if it were an extension of his own limbs—one swing crushes warm-bloods and their so-called fine armor alike into a single mass of flesh and metal.

The soft metal cannot protect his tough scaled hide, but it makes his massive form gleam brilliantly—allowing the Saurus warriors behind him to easily follow his shining silhouette and the trail of blood he carves through the enemy ranks.

Sharp, heavy, and imbued with the wild blessing of the beast god Itzl, this great axe—honed by a host of Skink craftsmen—is capable of decapitating even the thickest-necked Carnosaur in a single stroke.
Assembled from the most prized trophies of Gu Ke Jia's kills, this thick carapace—capable of withstanding the searing heat of the Solar Engine—makes arrows and bolts little more than an itch.
'The blood of the Old Ones, the blessing of the beast god—these make them mightier than their own kind.'
'Battles that involve Gu Kahn tend to end swiftly—a Kroxigor drenched in gore and severed limbs, smashing through the enemy line, is a fearsome sight to any warm-blood.'
'They tire not. They break not. They are unstoppable.'
'When that tall, gleaming Kroxigor appears on the battlefield, the army's spirits soar.'
'From the moment this pair of Twin Kroxigors crawled from the spawning pools, they were different—massive, powerful, and touched with a rare glimmer of intelligence.'
'The blood of the Old Ones, the blessing of the beast god—these make them mightier than their own kind.'
'A hunger for challenging strong foes and a desire to prove himself have made Gu Ke Jia grow stronger with every battle.'
'This raging beast can carve a bloody path straight through a crowd.'
'Best not draw its attention—its mind isn't quite sharp enough to grasp the concept of holding back...'
'From the moment this pair of Twin Kroxigors crawled from the spawning pools, they were different—massive, powerful, and touched with a rare glimmer of intelligence.'

A colossal beast built from bone and blazing fire, bearing the Blood God's dread pronouncement as it leads the frenzied faithful through fields of bloody mud, leaving scorched bone and severed limbs in its wake.

A colossal beast built from bone and blazing fire, bearing the Blood God's dread pronouncement as it leads the frenzied faithful through fields of bloody mud, leaving scorched bone and severed limbs in its wake.
When the dragon soars through the heavens, its might strikes terror; when the dragon battles in the wilds, its blood runs dark and gold.

The prototypes of these war machines date back to the prospecting frenzy of the Golden Age, but as swarms of engineers and miners were swallowed by the Greenskin tide, they too were buried beneath rubble—until recent excavations brought them back into the light. Now, survivors of that terrible calamity have mounted these refurbished, mass-produced machines, ready to settle the score with Greenskins and rat-filth alike.

The Hairpin of Longing for the Palace is carved from thousand-year-old cassia wood and tempered with shadow magic. When Liu Wang Que set out with Yuan Bo for Lustria, Hong Ying solemnly presented this hairpin to her—the shadow power sealed within can amplify spells while concealing the caster's presence.

The Golden Feather Robe is woven from moonlit silk bestowed by the Moon Empress, threaded with fine gold, and draped with a cape of molted feathers from the spirit crows kept by the Cassia Confidants. Woven over the course of a year by the Celestial Court's weaving bureau, it is Liu Wang Que's most distinctive mark of identity.

Liu Wang Que shrewdly foiled a plot by Tzeentch's followers to destroy the [Mirror of the Cassia Soul], earning great renown. [Shadowdance] brought it to her from the Moon Empress's garden as a gift—legend says the mirror was forged by the Moon Empress herself, containing within it a thread of pure lunar essence. Its frame is adorned with patterns of cassia branches and leaves, and on its back is carved an ancient inscription: 'The moon shines upon a thousand gates; its shadow follows but one soul.'

[Mirror Bloom] and [Shadowdance] are a devoted pair of Great Moon Luan, said to carry a fragment of the Moon Empress's power. Upon hearing the cry of these two birds, the [Black Jade Crow Marquis] can commune with the Wind of Yin and transform into the divine bird Yue Zhuo.

The Moonlight Edict is the seal of office and token of authority for the Deputy Overseer of the Cassia Confidants, and Liu Wang Que's proof of command over its agents. Within the jade pendant, a single drop of pure shadow essence is sealed through Yin sorcery, resonating with the [Mirror of the Cassia Soul]. On the battlefield, the Moonlight Edict can unleash a barrier of shadow to protect its bearer.

When Hong Ying first founded the Cassia Confidants, he personally forged this long blade for Liu Wang Que using dark ink flame, as her battlefield weapon. Though the Cassia Confidants' Deputy Overseer is a woman, she is by no means one to be trifled with.

A great shield forged specifically for the terracotta commander, crafted from the dark stone of Kun Lan. Its surface bears a relief of the Dragon God in glorious majesty, and its body is unbreakable, able to block even the heaviest blows from monstrous foes.
Whether arrow, blade, fang, or claw, the divine dragon statue coiled around the beast-devouring motif holds nothing but bone-deep contempt for such crude methods of slaughter.
A rare crystal from the peak of Kun Lan is set into Yang Xing's armor, containing within it the might of the Heavens, capable of unleashing lethal magical energy in battle.

The sword borne by the Chief of the Terracotta Guard, said to have been forged by the Dragon Emperor's own hand. Its blade is engraved with patterns of the Wind of Yang, and it glows with dazzling starlight whenever Chaos assails the Long Wall.
A mysterious spirit serpent bred by the Jade Blood Taoist Temple, its body a deep jade-green, perpetually steeped in elixirs. None but those of the Jade Blood lineage can master it.
Created by the Jade Blood Taoists through the fusion of vampiric sorcery with Xi Zhao alchemy, these elixirs flow like liquid jade, possessing both restorative and corrosively venomous properties.
Jade Blood Rune Art is the Jade Blood Taoists' unique development of the Winds of Magic. This Jade Blood Taoist has mastered the art, wielding its runes with effortless skill.
For a thousand years, all who join the Jade Blood Taoist Temple swear an oath: 'Though I bear the undying blood curse, I shall never consort with Chaos and corruption.'
Hidden agents are everywhere, the people live in peace, and no bandit dares to stir.
Wherever her eyes and ears reach, corruption finds no refuge, and all trades flourish.
Intelligence flows freely, and engineering projects proceed in perfect order.
Bandits are hunted down, trade routes secured, and the roads stretch unhindered for ten thousand li.
All things are gathered and known, opportunities seized quietly, without a sound.
Intelligence intercepts enemy resources—never returning empty-handed.
Every troop deployment across the realm is known to her—elite forces answer at a moment's notice.
Wounded soldiers return to the ranks, ambushes are laid in wait—every victory becomes capital for the next battle.
The enemy walks into the net—every ambush has already been foreseen.
Hidden agents spread throughout enemy territory, moving like fish through water, spending resources like sand slipping through fingers.
Foreseeing weather and terrain alike, the army marches as if over level ground, leaving nothing standing in enemy lands.
Intelligence leads the way, striking like thunder—our forces arrive before the enemy can even react.
March like the wind—too swift to catch.
Formation like a dense forest—too dangerous to breach.
Assault like fire—spreading as an unstoppable blaze.
Dark clouds veil the moon—come and go without a trace.
Thunderous force incarnate—the enemy is ground to dust.
My body may perish, but my resolve shall never falter.
Sharpen the blade, train the steed—prepare well, and disaster shall find no purchase.
Foremost among the three armies, trampling mountains and rivers underfoot.

The Terracotta Guard is truly a miracle of ancient times—Shen Yang first cast these guardians a thousand years ago. Now, as heaven and earth are thrown into turmoil, the Celestial Court has once again summoned the spirit of the [Frontier Sentinel].
This colossal construct is the Dragon Emperor's proudest creation—once given an order, it carries it out without hesitation, even if it means being smashed to pieces.
Every towering, mighty terracotta guardian is modeled after the image of a great warrior—and Yang Xing's form is said to be based on the controversial figure of Xin Wu from Cathayan mythology.
The Emblem of the Vast Dragon blazes brightly upon his form, a reminder to all that this great creation must never be provoked.
On the road to the Towering Capital, travelers find comfort standing beneath the shadow of the great terracotta guardian statue—its gaze forever fixed upon the distant Long Wall.

Legend holds that Yang Xing was the very first sentinel shaped by the Dragon Emperor, and foremost among the four legendary sentinels. By the Dragon Emperor's command, he has silently guarded the Long Wall and the Towering Capital for a thousand years.

The oldest of the chief constructs stands as the very model for the army—he never ceases to steel the resolve of his comrades, whether they are forged of jade, carved from stone, or made of flesh and blood.
Terracotta Guards lie scattered throughout Cathay, awaiting the next call to war—and the name of the [Frontier Sentinel] is the surest way to awaken them.
The more silent a man, the more he warrants careful attention... this is truly a timeless piece of wisdom!
Near or far, wherever they hide, none escape the Dragon God's scornful gaze.
No matter what cunning tricks the enemy uses to infiltrate Cathay, they will meet Yang Xing's great shield head-on.
A great blade of death for the enemies of Cathay, and a tremendous inspiration to loyal soldiers.
Yang Xing leans on his sword and points to the heavens; the Terracotta Imperial Guard Legion stands ready to charge as one, following the sweep of the Radiant Star Divine Sword.
